title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1970-02-05

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear audience recording of an early‑1970 show, opening strong with China Cat Sunflower and maintaining high energy through the encore.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the surprisingly pristine sound of this audience tape, calling it as clear as a soundboard while retaining pleasant crowd ambience. The performance is described as immersive and consistently engaging from the opening China Cat Sunflower right through to the final encore, with no noted flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed 5‑star reviews praise both the exceptional audio clarity of an audience source and a compelling, energetic performance throughout the show.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Extremely clear for an audience recording; faint crowd noise adds atmosphere but does not muddy the mix. No dropouts or balance issues reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set opens powerfully with China Cat Sunflower and sustains its momentum through interludes, banter, and a satisfying encore.
